acceptance.identity: served model id matched the expected name
acceptance.reasoning: separate reasoning_content phase with the correct answer still in content
acceptance.tools: forced call returned valid arguments whose result round-tripped into the follow-up
acceptance.vision: two solid-colour PNGs answered Red and Blue

gaps.concurrency_4: no concurrency-4 point was reached, so nothing is claimed about batching behaviour
gaps.not_run: the 131072-token cells and 28 samples of the declared grid did not start inside the wall deadline
gaps.serve_log: the engine's own request log was not copied back before the pod was deleted; per-request timings and cache counts survive in each raw sweep record instead

rows.note: genuinely cold: every request in the cell observed cached_tokens 0, so prompt tokens divided by TTFT is a real prefill rate

rows.prefill_null_reason: the cell observed a reused cached prefix, so prompt tokens divided by TTFT is a cache-read rate, not prefill; a genuinely cold cell reports the rate instead

skipped_points.reason: fewer than two samples with distinct raw-artifact hashes; the driver's wall deadline cut the point after its first sample

timing_basis.decode: per-stream steady decode pace from the engine's mean TPOT; never the client's blended aggregate
timing_basis.end_to_end: output tokens / (TTFT + sum of inter-token latencies), dispatch to last token
timing_basis.prefill: prompt tokens / TTFT, published at concurrency 1 and only for cells that observed cached_tokens 0
timing_basis.ttft: client-observed monotonic dispatch to first token, pooled per-request percentile

label: PARTIAL PROTOCOL-V2 RUN — the priority-1 model on the 16 GB tier. Functional acceptance is VERIFIED: identity, chat, a separate reasoning phase with the correct answer, a forced tool call whose result round-trips, and vision (Red / Blue solid-colour PNGs) all returned verdict accepted at the full 131072-token window, and MTP was observed live at a 99.27% acceptance rate. The speed grid is PARTIAL: the driver's budget-coupled wall deadline stopped it after 2 of 12 (context, concurrency, scenario) points completed (7 of 36 samples, each with its own raw record and hash), one point finished only its first sample and is recorded as skipped rather than as a row, and 28 samples never started. This is not a full-protocol run and confers no validated badge.

measurement_protocol.sampling_basis: the engine's own tokenizer encoded the exact token string and the client verified the re-encoded length before any measured request
measurement_protocol.wall_bound: the driver derived its sweep deadline from the remaining rental budget, not from a fixed step cap

mtp.note: an observed speculation rate on this run; this is NOT a speedup claim

defect_found_and_fixed.detail: the gate prompt for every window was built from the same repeated sentence, so the wider window's cold gate hit the narrower window's cached prefix (cached_tokens=32000) and the gate failed closed
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: the gate now distinguishes its first tokens per window; both gates re-passed with cached_tokens=0

preflight_gate.note: each window's gate observed cached_tokens 0 before any measured request

provenance.note: Public sanitized copy of the run's recorder artifacts. The originals (including the unredacted driver summary and the raw sweep records) remain local and intact in the private campaign checkout; this mirror does not modify them. The pod's routable public IP and SSH port were replaced with the canonical redaction tokens in acceptance.log and sweep.log; the 0.0.0.0 bind addresses in startup.log and config.yml are container-local bindings, not routable addresses, and are left intact.
